key: CAIN: Heyyyy, \PN!
en: CAIN: Heyyyy, \PN!
ja: カイン: やっほー、\PN!

key: CAIN: They let me up here for this one~
en: CAIN: They let me up here for this one~
ja: カイン: 今回はここまで上がらせてもらえたんだ～

key: Figured I'd get bored waiting out there, haha.
en: Figured I'd get bored waiting out there, haha.
ja: 外で待ってるの退屈だと思ってさ、ははっ。

key: Anyway, I'm not great at chess, but I'll bet you can figure this one out, right?
en: Anyway, I'm not great at chess, but I'll bet you can figure this one out, right?
ja: まあ、ボクはチェス得意じゃないけど、キミなら解けるでしょ～?

key: We are but mere pawns, yet you may find our defensive line more Sturdy than you expect...
en: We are but mere pawns, yet you may find our defensive line more Sturdy than you expect...
ja: われらはただのポーン。だが守りの列は　思ったよりがんじょうだぞ……

key: The Pokémon out at the start are always Pawns! Remember that!
en: The Pokémon out at the start are always Pawns!  Remember that!
ja: 最初から出ているポケモンは　いつもポーンだ! 覚えておけ!

key: Your next opponent awaits.
en: Your next opponent awaits.
ja: 次の相手が待っている。

key: CAIN: Heyy, done already?
en: CAIN: Heyy, done already?
ja: カイン: あれ、もう終わったの～?

key: CAIN: Okayy, well!
en: CAIN: Okayy, well!
ja: カイン: よーし、それじゃ!

key: Oh! You're attacking the king with both the Rook and Knight. Clever~
en: Oh! You're attacking the king with both the Rook and Knight. Clever~
ja: おっ! ルークとナイトの両方でキングをねらってるんだ。かしこいね～

key: But uhhhh, couldn't it just move away?
en: But uhhhh, couldn't it just move away?
ja: でもさぁ、逃げられちゃうんじゃない?

key: CAIN: I think that's it! Great job, \PN~
en: CAIN: I think that's it! Great job, \PN~
ja: カイン: それで正解だと思う! よくやったね、\PN～

key: And that's my cue to move forward too~
en: And that's my cue to move forward too~
ja: ボクも先へ進む合図だね～

key: See you again soon!
en: See you again soon!
ja: またすぐ会おうね!

key: Ooh, that looks really good! Except...
en: Ooh, that looks really good! Except...
ja: おお、すごくいい感じ! でも……

key: I think the King can still move out to those white spaces.
en: I think the King can still move out to those white spaces.
ja: キングはまだ　あの白いマスに逃げられると思うな。

key: Is there a way you can attack them both?
en: Is there a way you can attack them both?
ja: その両方をねらう手はない?

key: Oh! So you've got the King in check from your Rook!
en: Oh! So you've got the King in check from your Rook!
ja: おっ! ルークでキングに王手をかけたんだね!

key: But couldn't it just move away?
en: But couldn't it just move away?
ja: でも、逃げられちゃうんじゃない?

key: Oh wow! That's a smooth set-up there!
en: Oh wow! That's a smooth set-up there!
ja: うわぁ! きれいな組み立てだね!

key: Exceeeeept it looks like the King can just capture your Bishop to escape.
en: Exceeeeept it looks like the King can just capture your Bishop to escape.
ja: でもぉ～ キングにビショップを取られて逃げられちゃいそう。

key: Exceeeeept it looks like the King can just slip away to that one tile still.
en: Exceeeeept it looks like the King can just slip away to that one tile still.
ja: でもぉ～ キングはまだ　あのマスにするりと逃げられそうだよ。

key: Oh, I see. You're putting the Black King in Check, but if you put your Rook there, then can't they take it?
en: Oh, I see. You're putting the Black King in Check, but if you put your Rook there, then can't they take it?
ja: なるほど、黒のキングに王手だね。でもそこにルークを置いたら　取られちゃわない?

key: Oh! I see, you've got your Knight placing them in check.
en: Oh! I see, you've got your Knight placing them in check.
ja: おっ! ナイトで王手をかけたんだね。

key: But uhhh, couldn't Black just capture that Knight to get out of check?
en: But uhhh, couldn't Black just capture that Knight to get out of check?
ja: でもさぁ、黒はそのナイトを取って　王手を外せるんじゃない?

key: Aaah, so you're using the Rook to put the King in check there.
en: Aaah, so you're using the Rook to put the King in check there.
ja: ああ、ルークでキングに王手をかけたんだ。

key: But um, wouldnt Black just take that Rook with their own?
en: But um, wouldnt Black just take that Rook with their own?
ja: でもさ、黒は自分のルークでそれを取っちゃわない?

key: Uhm... Wait. Is Black even in Check right now?
en: Uhm... Wait. Is Black even in Check right now?
ja: えっと……待って。そもそも黒は今　王手なの?

key: CAIN: You so-totes got this~
en: CAIN: You so-totes got this~
ja: カイン: キミなら絶対いけるって～

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
